intro_topics.text: How are you feeling about the show?
intro_topics.response: I'm a bit nervous, but I think it's going well.

intro_topics.text: You look great today! Who are you wearing?
intro_topics.response: Oh, thank you! It's just something I threw on.

intro_topics.text: I heard some rumors about you. Care to comment?
intro_topics.response: Excuse me? I don't listen to baseless gossip.

intro_topics.text: What are you most excited for today?
intro_topics.response: I really hope to make a connection with someone special.
I suppose so. Did you have a real question?

intro_topics.text: The fans seem to really love you!
intro_topics.response: Really? That makes me so happy to hear!
Oh, noticed? Yeah, just a trim.

intro_topics.text: Why did your last relationship end?
intro_topics.response: That is extremely personal and none of your business.

intro_topics.text: What made you sign up for this show in the first place?
intro_topics.response: I figured… why not? Life’s short, and I needed a change.

intro_topics.text: Who do you think is your biggest competition here?
intro_topics.response: Honestly? There are a few strong personalities. We'll see.

intro_topics.text: What’s a red flag that would make you walk away immediately?
intro_topics.response: Dishonesty. If I catch even a whiff of it, I'm out.

intro_topics.text: What’s your best quality in relationships?
intro_topics.response: I’m loyal. Maybe too loyal sometimes, but it’s who I am.

intro_topics.text: Your DMs must be wild right now. How are you handling the attention?
intro_topics.response: I’m trying not to look. It’s… a lot.

intro_topics.text: What would your family say about you being here?
intro_topics.response: They’d act surprised, but they’re secretly thrilled.

intro_topics.text: Is there anything you’re nervous the audience might find out about you?
intro_topics.response: That question feels like a trap. Next.

intro_topics.text: How do you handle conflict when you’re upset?
intro_topics.response: I take a minute, then I talk it through. I don't like playing games.

followup_confidence.text: Confidence is key! You'll do great.
followup_confidence.response: Thanks, I needed to hear that!

followup_gossip.text: Any tea you want to spill?
followup_gossip.response: Not right now. My lips are sealed.

followup_compliment.text: You're the star of the show!

followup_dating.text: Is it to impress anyone special?

followup_apology.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to offend.
followup_apology.response: It's fine. Just watch it next time.

followup_push.text: Come on, the audience wants to know!
followup_push.response: I said no comment! This interview is over.

followup_change_subject.response: The catering is decent, I guess.

followup_romance.response: There is someone... but I won't say who yet.

followup_work.text: What do you do for work?

followup_hobby.text: What do you do for fun?

followup_message.response: Just thank you! I love you all!

followup_looks_good.response: Thanks, my stylist is a genius.

followup_push_hard.text: The public has a right to know!
followup_push_hard.response: Security! Get this person away from me!

followup_backstory_support.text: That takes guts. I respect the leap.
followup_backstory_support.response: Thank you. I’m trying to be brave about it.

followup_backstory_probe.text: Was it heartbreak, boredom, or something else?
followup_backstory_probe.response: A mix. Mostly me realizing I was stuck.

followup_backstory_mock.text: So you came for attention. Classic.
followup_backstory_mock.response: Wow. No. I'm here for real reasons, actually.

followup_rival_respect.text: I like that you’re staying respectful. Classy.
followup_rival_respect.response: It’s not my style to tear people down.

followup_rival_neutral.text: So you’re keeping your cards close. Fair enough.
followup_rival_neutral.response: Exactly. I’m just watching and learning.

followup_rival_stir.text: Name names. Who annoys you the most?
followup_rival_stir.response: I’m not doing that. Don’t try to bait me.

followup_redflags_validate.response: It took me a while to learn it, but yeah.

followup_redflags_judge.text: Sounds like you’re picky. Good luck with that.
followup_redflags_judge.response: Or maybe I just know what I deserve.

followup_strength_praise.text: Loyalty like that is rare. Someone will be lucky.

followup_strength_followup.text: What does loyalty look like for you day-to-day?
followup_strength_followup.response: Showing up. Being consistent. Not disappearing when it’s hard.

followup_strength_doubt.text: Loyal people usually get played. Are you naive?
followup_strength_doubt.response: No. I’m careful. Don’t confuse kindness with weakness.

followup_socials_support.text: Protect your peace. You don’t owe anyone access.

followup_socials_neutral.text: Do you read any of it at all?
followup_socials_neutral.response: A little. Mostly I regret it immediately.

followup_socials_pushy.text: Show us the weirdest DM you got. Come on!
followup_socials_pushy.response: Absolutely not. That’s gross and invasive.

followup_family_wholesome.response: Yeah… they’re not perfect, but they care.

followup_family_neutral.text: Would they approve of who you date here?
followup_family_neutral.response: They’d have opinions. They always do.

followup_family_insult.text: So they’re attention-seekers too. Runs in the family?
followup_family_insult.response: Don’t talk about my family like that.

followup_secret_backoff.response: Good. Because I’m not playing that game.

followup_secret_press.text: If it’s not a big deal, just say it.
followup_secret_press.response: No. And you’re being weird about it.

followup_conflict_respect.text: That level of self-control is attractive.
followup_conflict_respect.response: Thanks. I’ve worked on it a lot.

followup_conflict_neutral.text: Do you cool off alone or with friends?
followup_conflict_neutral.response: Alone first. Then I talk to someone I trust.

followup_conflict_provoke.text: So you think you’re better than everyone who gets emotional?
followup_conflict_provoke.response: No. But you’re clearly trying to twist my words.
